# Credit Risk and Loan Appraisal Review Notes

This document details critical review items for the Credit & Loans department:

*   Review the borrower credit score standard update.
*   Monitor the interest rates standard update.
*   Review the default risk based on audit findings.
*   Review the collateral value quarterly.
*   Review the default risk for strategy 2026.
